CheckEmailContainer/the /check-email page uses Clerk's signIn.createEmailLinkFlow()/startEmailLinkFlow() (or equivalent) to long-poll the sign-in attempt it created, so opening the link on a second device completes the sign-in and navigates the ORIGINATING device to the dashboard (or validated return_to) once Clerk reports verified; the second device (where onVerifiedOnOtherDevice/ClientMismatch fire) renders a distinct, truthful state — e.g. 'verified-on-other-device', 'you're signed in on your other device' — with no 'send new link' CTA that could supersede the completing attempt; screens.md documents the new SCR-02 (polling/verified) and SCR-04 (verified-on-other-device) states; ADR-0001's Consequences section gains a note on the email-link cross-device model; test-plan.md:36 gets a real (not just planned) e2e scenario for AC-02b, and e2e/auth-dashboard.spec.ts adds it (or an explicitly-named skip if a live Clerk instance still isn't available, per the existing T47 pattern — never silently green); SsoCallbackContainer.test.tsx:109-123,249-267 are rewritten to assert the new decided outcome, not the previous deviation

tasks.title: Re-validate or invalidate persisted linked-identity mappings instead of trusting them forever

tasks.title: Give the sign-up branch's verified-elsewhere screen a non-destructive recovery CTA

tasks.title: Scope linked-identity invalidation to actual email changes and cover the canonical-account side
tasks.dod: the webhook no longer calls linkedIdentities.invalidate() on every user.updated event regardless of whether the verified email changed — it only invalidates when the computed verifiedEmail actually differs from what's on record, so an unrelated profile edit (display name, avatar, metadata) does not re-show the 'linked' banner and does not cost an extra Clerk fetch; invalidate() also clears rows where the CHANGED identity is the canonicalUserId, not only where it's the identityId, so a canonical account's email change also clears mappings that point at it; session.test.ts:117's 'clears the linked banner ... with only one Clerk fetch total' behavior still holds for a same-email update; a test drives the webhook and getSessionUser against the same database to prove the two paths actually meet

tasks.title: Guard the /check-email poll against cancellation/unmount races and remount re-sends

tasks.title: Fix CheckEmailContainer tests to match the real Clerk SignInStatus contract and cover the single-send guarantee

tasks.title: Retry or force-clear the client session when signOut() rejects after the server's 204
